images.alt: Persistence from Geometry. The same 24-flag hole has a strict exit with 20 walls discharged and none opened in one surrounding field; in the nested field the offer discharges 30 and opens 10.
Same hole and containing face: the nested field discharges 30 walls and opens 10; the contrast discharges 20 and opens none.

Refinement comparison: a single-site field changes from one strict exit to none in a read-only correspondence; the nested field's 64 walls and 30 discharged, 20 opened prediction match its GPU receipt.
Of 480 adjacent pairs, 60 have a strict exit and 420 have none under the recorded offered family. The full classification is computed over bound incidence; GPU receipts witness all 60 exits.
